Question Choices: Fill: A shop sells boxes of pencils and pens. One purchase of 3 pencil boxes and 2 pen boxes costs $\$19$. Another purchase of 5 pencil boxes and 1 pen box costs $\$22$. What is the price of one pencil box? Give the exact value; use a fraction if necessary. Do not round.
Hints: Set up a system of equations: $3p + 2b = 19$ and $5p + 1b = 22$;Use elimination by multiplying the second equation
Solution: x is pencil-box price and y is pen-box price, in dollars. System: 3 × x+2 × y=19; 5 × x+y=22. Multiply equation 1 by 1 and equation 2 by -2, then add to cancel y: (-7)x=-25, so x=25/7. Substitute back to obtain y=29/7. Check both equations: 3(25/7)+2(29/7)=19; 5(25/7)+1(29/7)=22. A truncated or rounded decimal is not this exact value. Requested answer: 25/7.

Question Choices: Fill: Solve the system $4x - y = 7$ and $2x + y = 5$. What is $x$?
Hints: Add equations when opposite coefficients cancel the requested variable.
Solution: System: 4 × x-y=7; 2 × x+y=5. Multiply equation 1 by 1 and equation 2 by 1, then add to cancel y: (6)x=12, so x=2. Substitute back to obtain y=1. Check both equations: 4(2)+-1(1)=7; 2(2)+1(1)=5. Requested answer: 2.

Question Choices: Fill: One line is $y = 5x - 8$. The other line has $y = 2x + 7$. Find the x-value of the solution.
Hints: Set the two expressions for y equal to each other
Solution: System: y=5 × x-8; y=2 × x+7. Isolate y: y=(5)x+(-8). Substitute into the other equation: (-2)x+(1)[(5)x+(-8)]=7. Combine: (3)x=15, so x=5. Then y=(5)(5)+(-8)=17. Check both equations: -5(5)+1(17)=-8; -2(5)+1(17)=7. Requested answer: 5.

Question Choices: Fill: Solve for $y$ in the system $y = -3x + 4$ and $2x + y = -11$.
Hints: Replace one variable with its equivalent expression, then solve and substitute back.
Solution: System: y=-3 × x+4; 2 × x+y=-11. Isolate y: y=(-3)x+(4). Substitute into the other equation: (2)x+(1)[(-3)x+(4)]=-11. Combine: (-1)x=-15, so x=15. Then y=(-3)(15)+(4)=-41. Check both equations: 3(15)+1(-41)=4; 2(15)+1(-41)=-11. Requested answer: -41.

Solution: System: y=7 × x+3; 5 × x+y=-12. Isolate y: y=(7)x+(3). Substitute into the other equation: (5)x+(1)[(7)x+(3)]=-12. Combine: (12)x=-15, so x=-5/4. Then y=(7)(-5/4)+(3)=-23/4. Check both equations: -7(-5/4)+1(-23/4)=3; 5(-5/4)+1(-23/4)=-12. Requested answer: -5/4.

Solution: Substitute x=4 into y=-2 × x+9: y=-2 × (4)+9=1. Requested answer: 1.
